steps.purpose: 只点选已确认的灰尘，不覆盖眼睛、文字和胶片颗粒

steps.purpose: 轻度降噪，保留可识别纹理和胶片颗粒
steps.parameterReference: {"strength":0..10=6,"preserveDetails":0..100=60,"reduceColorNoise":0..100=45,"sharpenDetails":0..100=25,"removeJpegArtifact":bool}

steps.purpose: 观察直方图后恢复中间调，黑白场不硬截断
steps.parameterReference: {"inBlack":0..253=0,"gamma":0.01..9.99=1,"inWhite":2..255=255,"outBlack":0..255=0,"outWhite":0..255=255,"red":json,"green":json,"blue":json,"eyedropper":json} (top level = composite; per channel {"inBlack","gamma","inWhite","outBlack","outWhite"} under red/green/blue, gray, cyan/magenta/yellow/black or lightness/a/b; eyedropper = the dialog's Set Black/Neutral Gray/White Point picker {"point":"black|gray|white","at":[x,y],"size":1..101=1} or {"point",…,"color":[r,g,b] 0..1}: black/white set each channel's input black/white to the sample, gray each channel's gamma so the sample turns neutral at its luma; RGB and Grayscale (no gray) only, applied over the given levels) + {"path":"work"|saved path name|{…path}? checks: 人物边缘与字形未被改造
